## Explain it to a human

In 1–3 plain-language sentences, explain the problem and why a design choice is needed.

## What needs to change

State the decision or design outcome needed, current limitation, affected architectural responsibilities/contracts/trust boundaries, and material constraints. Distinguish proposals from accepted requirements. Link a QART/RFC/spec when alternatives or technical detail require broader review.

## Done when

- [ ] [Material question or choice is decided by its accountable owner, with evidence]
- [ ] [Relevant security, compatibility, operational, and rollback consequences are addressed]
- [ ] [Accepted decision is linked to the right ADR, specification, or delivery issue if required]

## Tracking

- **Priority:** P0 / P1 / P2 / P3 — one-sentence repository-global rationale.
- **Status:** Draft / Needs evidence / In review / Needs decision / Accepted / Superseded.
- **Decision owner:** [Owner, if known]
- **Blocked by:** [Missing evidence or approval + owner, if relevant]
- **Alternatives:** [Short options or link to QART; never invent acceptance]
- **Not included:** [Material boundary, if relevant]
- **Evidence:** [Existing RFC / ADR / QART / related issue / review links]

Do not embed a second full design document in this issue. Record accepted durable design choices in their authoritative home and keep this issue as the current decision index.
